# Merlay 0.6.2 — VS Code markdown preview integration and fence editor polish

> **Mermaid, your way.** A visual overlay editor for Mermaid diagrams.

## 🔧 Improvements & Fixes

- **VS Code Markdown Preview "Edit visually" Action**: Docked an "Edit visually" action button directly beside the diagram zoom controls in VS Code's native Markdown preview, allowing instant transition from reading previews to visual diagram editing.
- **Extension URI Handler Dispatch**: Dispatched preview edit triggers via `vscode://dev-hashemi.merlay/edit-fence` protocol handling, preventing VS Code's preview webview from intercepting clicks as markdown hyperlinks and reliably resolving local, remote, and split-editor source documents.
- **Resilient Fence Indexing & Query Parsing**: Accurately counts all mermaid blocks—including unrendered or error states—and reliably parses URI parameters across encoded and decoded queries so the exact corresponding diagram always opens.
- **Full Tab Visual Editor**: Opening a diagram from the preview or CodeLens now opens as a full editor tab (`ViewColumn.Active`) instead of a narrow side split, maximizing canvas editing space.
- **Clean Canvas Remounting**: Remounts the visual editor webview and canvas when switching diagrams within a reused editor tab, preventing blank views and stale layout state.

## Install (Obsidian)

**BRAT (Beta):** Add `https://github.com/dev-hashemi/merlay` in BRAT → Add Beta plugin.

**Manual:** Download `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` from the assets below into your vault under `.obsidian/plugins/merlay/`, then enable **Merlay** under Settings → Community plugins.

Requires Obsidian `1.4.0` or newer. Desktop and mobile supported.

## Install (VS Code)

Install from the [VS Code Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=dev-hashemi.merlay) or [Open VSX](https://open-vsx.org/extension/dev-hashemi/merlay), or grab the `.vsix` attached below → *Extensions → … → Install from VSIX*.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dev-hashemi/merlay/compare/0.6.1...0.6.2
